concepts.name: be_willing_to_speak_in_accents
concepts.gloss: A is disposed to speak in any accent without reluctance

concepts.name: be_culturally_sensitive
concepts.gloss: A acts with awareness and respect for cultural context

concepts.name: exaggerate_portrayals
concepts.gloss: A overstates or caricatures an accent in a way that distorts it

concepts.name: use_stereotypes
concepts.gloss: A relies on reductive generalizations about a group when speaking

concepts.name: speaking_in_accents
concepts.gloss: A is actually speaking with an accent at the time
concepts.inference: the 'while' condition in the clause presupposes a state of speaking in an accent that the clause does not define

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: A is the authority level assigned to rules in the 'Use accents respectfully' section
